items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 114:1
items.html: (To the question) The Nukva, from her root, is nothing but the point of the ending of ZA, namely the point of the chest, from the aspect of the vessels. And she is the aspect of the Keter of the Nukva, for in the vessels it is always discerned that the upper ones grow first. And she is a point under the Yesod, from the aspect of the lights that clothe in the vessels, and from this aspect she is the Malchut of the Nukva, namely the tenth phase. For in the lights it is always discerned that the lower ones enter first. Therefore, before the Nesira she has nothing but the aspect of her root alone, which is the tenth phase, as above. And after the Nesira she takes all the aspects of the Nukva that are in the body of ZA, which are the Malchuts of his ten Sefirot, from Keter to the Malchut within him, and then she is built into a complete Partzuf of her own. (Item 144).
